_comment: Collaboration decomposition for TLMC v6. artist_scanner_ph2 regenerates new_artists.output.json from the directory listing and writes linked=[] for every circle, so re-running it DISCARDS this. Reapply 'linked' afterwards.
_method: 107 decompositions were derived mechanically: split only where every part is a circle existing independently in this release, trying the whole string before splitting so a name legitimately containing a separator survives. The remaining 139 were adjudicated individually against embedded tags, catalogue prefixes, cue/log credits and THBWiki/VGMdb; 'adjudication' records the verdict, confidence and evidence for each. Links are flattened to leaf circles: a link pointing at another collaboration mints a UUID no circle owns.

[コココソフト×趣味工房にんじんわいん]: [趣味工房にんじんわいん] Hobby atelier carrot wine
[UNKNOWN BEATS×ギャラクティック・リボルバー]: [ギャラクティック・リボルバー]
[ぶるっくりん☆すてーしょん& さくらゆっけ]: [ぶるっくりん☆すてーしょん]
[かっくん×ぶるっくりん☆すてーしょん×groovin' bullets]: [ぶるっくりん☆すてーしょん]
[Forest306 × ジャージと愉快な仲間たち]: [ジャージと愉快な仲間たち]
[Unprepared Orchestra×インスタントフィルハーモニー]: [インスタントフィルハーモニー] Instant Philharmonic

unresolved_left_standalone: [燃えるゴミ燃えないゴミ／金沢合同]
_generated_from: artist_scanner.discovery.new_artists.output.json as applied. Generate this file from the applied state, never from an intermediate: the first version of it was written from a pre-flattening working file and recorded a link pointing at another collaboration, which is exactly what the flattening removed.

[スタジオマグロフレーク×青波ゆらゆら].evidence: THBWiki gives 求鳴クロニクル 制作方 = スタジオマグロフレーク，青波ゆらゆら with staff mapping takenoko = スタジオマグロフレーク and かじ = 青波ゆらゆら (https://thwiki.cc/求鳴クロニクル); 青波ゆらゆら is a circle founded 2010-02, 主催 かじ (https://thwiki.cc/青波ゆらゆら). The six tracks alternate strictly between those two artists and [スタジオマグロフレーク] exists standalone.

[AIKA×Firaga].evidence: ORGANIZATION tag on all 10 tracks is 'Firaga Records' while every track artist is AIKA; TouhouDB credits the album to two entities, AIKA (Producer/Arranger) and Firaga Records (Circle/Publisher) — https://touhoudb.com/Al/28064, https://firagarecords.bandcamp.com/music.

[AGENT 0 x nekka].evidence: Both members exist standalone and the identical collaboration [AGENT 0 x nekka.] was already decomposed to [AGENT 0]+[nekka.] in Docs/v6-run-record/circle_collaborations.json; this dir is the same pairing without the trailing period.

[モヒカンサンドバッグVS×&幽幻屋].evidence: THBWiki gives XXXXX EX Stage R-21 制作方 = モヒカンサンドバッグ，幽幻屋, 类型 = 合作, with staff 昼/堕悪祭怪 = モヒカンサンドバッグ and silina/su-gaku = 幽幻屋; the circle page is 社团名 = モヒカンサンドバッグ with no 'VS' in the name (https://thwiki.cc/XXXXX_EX_Stage_R-21). The original release title was 'モヒカンサンドバッグ VS 幽幻屋', so VS is the separator. Both circles exist standalone and 堕悪祭怪 has 144 tracks in [モヒカンサンドバッグ].

[梶迫小道具店×Lab＊].evidence: THBWiki's page for the album 四季再花 lists 制作方 = 梶迫小道具店，Lab* and carries two circle categories (分类:Lab＊ and 分类:梶迫小道具店); Lab＊ has its own circle page (主催 白兎) — https://thwiki.cc/四季再花, https://thwiki.cc/Lab＊.

[秋葉工房 × A-One].evidence: Every track carries CIRCLE=秋葉工房 × A-One with album_artist=Various Artists; A-One exists standalone as [A-One (A1) - Eurobeat] (its dir holds Toho Eurobeat releases) and 秋葉工房 also appears in [Crazy Beats, 秋葉工房 & A-One].

[anos+plus×SAVE THE QUEEN].evidence: Catalogue ANSTQ-0001 concatenates ANos and STQ; track artists 式部 and SaiT both also appear in the standalone [SAVE THE QUEEN] dir.

[Pastel World×IbEthics].evidence: THBWiki gives 耀 -Astronomy- 制作方 = IbEthics，Pastel World, 类型 = 合作, 编号 PICK-0001, and IbEthics has its own circle page (主催 Gum34, ibethics.com) listing both discs — https://thwiki.cc/IbEthics. The EAC log is titled 'Pastel World & IbEthics - Hifuu Club Arrangement Compilation Album vol. 1' and [Pastel World] exists standalone.

[幽閉カタルシス×仮面の騎士].evidence: 幽閉サテライト's official site has a page 「松田悟志創作サークル 仮面の騎士」 describing 仮面の騎士 as a circle founded 2022 by actor 松田悟志 together with 幽閉カタルシス's representative, and BOOTH lists the releases as 「幽閉カタルシス×仮面の騎士」 — https://www.yuuhei-satellite.jp/group/松田悟志創作サークル-仮面の騎士, https://booth.pm/ja/items/5275698. 松田悟志 sings the 仮面の騎士 side; [幽閉カタルシス] exists standalone.

[Studio FE／Aleile].evidence: THBWiki gives イヤシノオト 制作方 = Studio FE，Aleile with staff 'Design : 兎弐参 （Studio FE）' and 'Recording/Mastering : Ciela （Aleile）' (https://thwiki.cc/イヤシノオト); Studio FE's own site declares 「同人サークルStudio FEのページ」 (http://fe.crap.jp/, archived). [Aleile] exists standalone and catalogue FEAL-0001 concatenates FE and AL.

[Spoo and Nick × 少年モラトリアム].evidence: Touhou Wiki's Spoo and Nick page describes 理想郷 as 'a collaborative album with 少年モラトリアム' (https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Spoo_and_Nick) and THBWiki has 少年モラトリアム as a circle, 主催 猫織 (https://thwiki.cc/少年モラトリアム). Track artists split between myu- (19 tracks in standalone [Spoo and Nick]) and 猫織.

[Mods Crisis∞ × Register6].evidence: Both halves exist standalone in all_circles.json as [Mods Crisis ∞] and [Register6]; only the space before ∞ defeated the auto-rule.

[Iemitsu.／A].evidence: THBWiki's circle page for Iemitsu. lists 曾用名 = Sound Iemitsu.，Iemitsu./A and states the circle released CDs under both those names before 2008 and under 'Iemitsu.' afterwards — https://thwiki.cc/Iemitsu.. The five albums bearing the name are IA-STYLE／Toho, IA-STYLE／Toho-J, SWRS, IA-STYLE／Toho-J／Fantasmix, IA-STYLE／B1 (IA = Iemitsu A), all on the SICD- catalogue, and no circle named 'A' exists anywhere.

[As／Hi Soundworks x 東部開拓地].evidence: The ／ belongs to the circle name As／Hi Soundworks, which exists standalone as [As／Hi Soundworks (As／Hi)] with 46 albums; [東部開拓地] also exists standalone.

[As／Hi Soundworks × Unity-Gain].evidence: Same As／Hi Soundworks standalone circle; [Unity-Gain] exists standalone and also appears in [Forest306+Unity-Gain].

[Alstroemeria Records × Studio ''Syrup C.evidence: Both exist standalone; the auto-rule only failed on the quote characters ('' vs “”). Studio “Syrup Comfiture” is already a linked member of [Studio “Syrup Comfiture” x Pizuya's Cell] in the v6 run record.

[signum／ii].evidence: en.touhouwiki.net: "signum/ii (read as halfsignum) is cittan*'s second project after 'Sprite Recordings'" (https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Signum/ii); the official site and Twitter are both 'halfsignum'. Eight albums on one SGNM- catalogue with album_artist 'signum/ii'.

[まいぺーす×ぷろぐれす].evidence: The circle's own X bio (@Mypace_Progress) reads 「2025/10/19… 活動開始予定のサークル「まいぺーす×ぷろぐれす」です！！ 代表 @Sugamaro_」 — one circle, one representative; THBWiki gives 制作方 = まいぺーす×ぷろぐれす as a single undelimited value with one circle category, and 秋例大祭12 registered it as a single booth. The × merely echoes the album title Mypace×Progress.

[Krik／Krak].evidence: Ten albums all released under the one name (album_artist 'Krik/Krak' / 'Krik／Krak'), and the v6 run record already decomposed [2.8mile×Krik／Krak] into [2.8mile] + [Krik／Krak], treating Krik／Krak as one indivisible circle.

[S.K'／Sound].evidence: Solo circle of すーさんK’, whose Twitter bio is literally 「すーさんK'@S.K'/Sound」 (https://x.com/konpakukishido) and whose BOOTH shop is skdashsound.booth.pm; TouhouDB records the reading as ｴｽｹ-ﾀﾞｯｼｭｻｳﾝﾄﾞ (S.K'-dash Sound), one name. All 38 tracks in the dir are by すーさんK’ on one SKDS- catalogue.

[Anglued×研鑽堂].evidence: The EAC log inside the album is named 'あんぐる～ど - 幻想Paradise V.log' and every track is by あぐら, producer of the standalone circle [あんぐる～ど] — Anglued is the romanisation of あんぐる～ど and both dirs hold the same 幻想Paradise series. 研鑽堂 is co-credited in album_artist but contributes no credited track.

[黒天羊舎×E-MP].evidence: Track artist spikin appears in the standalone [E-MP] dir; 黒天羊舎 is itself used as a per-track artist on this album, and [E-MP] exists standalone.

[Amateras Records × Melonbooks].evidence: THBWiki records this disc as 制作方 = Amateras Records, 发行方 = Melonbooks Records, 类型 = Omake (https://thwiki.cc/Amateras_Records_Melonbooks_Limited_Disc) — Melonbooks is the retailer/publisher, not a co-producing circle, and the same album (AMRS-0019) is duplicated inside the standalone [Amateras Records] dir with every track by an Amateras artist. Split anyway because both named parties are real entities that exist in this release ([Melonbooks Records] is a standalone circle), whereas leaving it whole would mint a fictitious artist 'Amateras Records × Melonbooks'. Downstream, the music should be attributed to Amateras Records.

[octet＊×Aether].evidence: octet* is a real circle owning the OSLA-#### catalogue used here (VGMdb album 9943 lists Organizations: octet*, catalogue OSLA-0004, site octet.biz), and composer Eru is Aether's 主催 (https://thwiki.cc/Aether); [Aether] exists standalone and recurs in several other collaboration dirs. Medium because VGMdb names only octet* as the organisation — the Aether half rests on the album_artist tag 'octet＊ x Aether' plus Eru's 5 tracks here.

[荒御霊 x As／Hi Soundworks].evidence: Both exist standalone; every track is credited '和泉幸奇;柊秀雪' and 柊秀雪 has 285 tracks under [As／Hi Soundworks (As／Hi)]. 荒御霊 is already a linked member of [荒御霊／音召缶] and [荒御霊 × 梶迫小道具店] in the v6 run record.

[TUMENECO × はにーぽけっと による].evidence: album_artist is exactly 'TUMENECO × はにーぽけっと' (the trailing 'による' is a directory-name artefact); the identical pairing [TUMENECO × はにーぽけっと] is already decomposed to these two members in the v6 run record.

[Lunatic×Bullets!].evidence: THBWiki gives 制作方 = Lunatic×Bullets! as a single undelimited value with exactly one circle category holding two albums, the second titled 'Lunatic Bullet' (the circle name minus the ×) — https://thwiki.cc/東方弾丸狂, https://thwiki.cc/Lunatic_Bullet. All three tracks are by らぎ alone, and neither 'Lunatic' nor 'Bullets!' exists as a circle anywhere in this release.

[コココソフト×趣味工房にんじんわいん].evidence: The album is the OST of the game メイドさんスレイヤー — コココソフト is the game circle and the music circle exists standalone as [趣味工房にんじんわいん] Hobby atelier carrot wine.

[俺++×音召缶].evidence: 俺++ exists standalone as [俺++(Includeore)] and [音召缶] exists standalone (already a linked member of [荒御霊／音召缶], [音召缶×こなぐすり] and [こなぐすり＆音召缶]).

[あんぐる～ど×ゲィりあんズ ].evidence: Tracks alternate between あぐら (7 tracks in standalone [あんぐる～ど]) and Tink; [あんぐる～ど] exists standalone.

[As／Hi Soundworks＆荒御霊].evidence: Both circles exist standalone; catalogue ARAM-0903 uses 荒御霊's ARA- prefix while album_artist reads 'As/Hi Soundworks'.

[ガネメ × 北斗藍].evidence: [ガネメ] exists standalone; 北斗藍 is credited as a per-track ARTIST in four different circle dirs ([ガネメ], [dat file records], [電解アンサー], [Heartful Zwei System]) and shares the joint credit 'ガネメ，北斗藍' on GACD-0020. THBWiki gives TAG FORCE 制作方 = ガネメ only and its page for 北斗藍/hokutoran shows 无所属社团 (no affiliated circle), 职位 编曲 — https://thwiki.cc/TAG%20FORCE, https://thwiki.cc/hokutoran. Split anyway because both are real, separately-credited parties (北斗藍 is an individual arranger, not a circle); keeping the string whole would mint a fictitious artist.

[Hasenpfeffer×asami×朽チ縄].evidence: [Hasenpfeffer] and [朽チ縄] exist standalone; asami is co-credited at directory level elsewhere too ([asami & Hasenpfeffer]) and all three names appear as per-track artists on this split.

[Silence Records × NIZI-RINGO].evidence: NIZI-RINGO is the same entity as the standalone circle [NiZi RiNGO] (260 tag hits in that dir); Silence Records has no standalone dir and is bracket-wrapped.

[非可逆リズム×ENVIRONMENTAL DEVELOPMENT].evidence: THBWiki gives the album 制作方 = 非可逆リズム，Environmental Development, 类型 = 全长，合作, staff モリモリあつし = 非可逆リズム and さうざう = Environmental Development; Environmental Development is a one-man circle, 主催 さうざう (https://thwiki.cc/Environmental_Development). [非可逆リズム] exists standalone. Member written in the circle's canonical mixed case rather than the directory's all-caps.

[イノライ×少女理論観測所×AbsoRute Zero].evidence: Documented verbatim in Docs/STEPS.md §5 example 2, and the AbsoЯute-spelled twin [イノライ×少女理論観測所×AbsoЯute Zero] is already decomposed to these three in the v6 run record.

[Bitter Quartz Vs mono music].evidence: [Bitter Quartz] exists standalone and catalogue BIMO-001 concatenates BItter and MOno; the eight tracks split between Volvic and Amethys.

[STEP×STEP].evidence: Five albums with album_artist 'STEP×STEP' / fullwidth 'ＳＴＥＰ×ＳＴＥＰ', and on STEPSTEP-01 the per-track ARTIST is also 'ＳＴＥＰ×ＳＴＥＰ' — the × is inside the circle's own name. No circle named 'STEP' exists in the release.

[ProjectMTG／時遊戯画].evidence: [時遊戯画] exists standalone with five albums on a JGCD- catalogue all named ○○曲集 (幻懐式曲集, 忘憂捧曲集, 時悠響曲集, 鎮魂祈曲集, 歳年嬉曲集) — the same series naming as this release, 想月綺曲集, which places the music side with 時遊戯画. Project M_T_G is separately credited as the release artist for 想月綺曲集～東方想月綺 Original Soundtrack～ (e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cOP67hp9svA), and album_artist here is 'ProjectM_T_G／時遊戯画' — game project plus music circle. Medium: no wiki page states the split outright, and I found no source that merges them either.

[灿华幻梦 × 墨染燐桦].evidence: THBWiki gives OVERPROTECTION 制作方 = 灿华幻梦，墨染燐桦 and 类型 = 全长，合作 (collaboration) — https://thwiki.cc/OVERPROTECTION; 墨染燐桦 is a separately registered label on DIZZYLAB (https://www.dizzylab.net/l/墨染燐桦/). Tracks alternate strictly between SEPHID (灿华幻梦's 音乐 member) and system [Σ], with one joint track 'S&S Munitions'; catalogue CHHM-0001 concatenates the two circles' initials.

[2nd Flush × 音乃葉].evidence: THBWiki gives Caprice 制作方 = 2nd Flush，音乃葉 with staff mapping 秋ノ = 2nd Flush and cheebow = 音乃葉; 音乃葉 is a circle, 主催 cheebow (https://thwiki.cc/音乃葉). [2nd Flush] exists standalone and 秋ノ has 13 tracks there.

[AlphaVersion Records×Qualial].evidence: The BOOTH listing for graphics states 「AlphaVersion Records / Qualialの合同コンピレーション」 (a joint compilation of the two) — https://booth.pm/ja/items/687572. Qualial is a real circle with its own QLCD- catalogue (organiser Yamaken, https://soundcloud.com/qualial); [AlphaVersion Records] exists standalone and catalogue AQCD-001 concatenates A and Q.

[Xceon vs Starving Trancer].evidence: Xceon and Starving Trancer are two aliases of the SAME person: THBWiki's page for Iceon gives 真名 = 瀬尾祐介 and 别名 = Xceon，Starving Trancer, listing both websites on one entry — https://thwiki.cc/Iceon. DIVERSE DIRECT registers the releasing circle as 'CIRCLE: Xceon / Starving Trancer' (https://www.diverse.direct/category/xceon-starving-trancer/), which is exactly the album_artist tag here; 'vs' is a self-versus alias pairing. 'REMIXED BY A-One' is title branding — only one of the three remixers (ELEMENTAS) is A-One.

[燃えるゴミ燃えないゴミ／金沢合同].evidence: 金沢合同 is not a circle. The project's own site (kanazawagogo.dojin.com, its registered URL in the archived るなフェス circle list) states 「金沢合同企画は、当初金沢に遊びに行こうという雑談から始まった企画です。…「燃えるごみ 燃えないごみ」はその話の中で決まったサークル名です」 — 金沢合同(企画) is the name of the joint undertaking and 燃えるゴミ燃えないゴミ is the circle name adopted for it, i.e. one entity under two labels. The 19 tracks are mostly 燃えるゴミ燃えないゴミ radio-skit material with guest songs by 狐夢想, myu314 and 石鹸屋 — individual participants in the project, not co-billed circles.

[As／Hi Soundworks × 梶迫小道具店].evidence: Both exist standalone; 柊秀雪 and Atori credits span both sides, and [荒御霊 × 梶迫小道具店] and [NO TITLE x 梶迫小道具店] were already decomposed with [梶迫小道具店] as a member.

[VAGUEDGE DIES FOR DIES IRAE vs. Heterod.evidence: THBWiki's circle page reads 社团名 = VAGUEDGE（VAGUEDGE DIES FOR DIES IRAE）, 主催 Hull — the long string is VAGUEDGE's own alternate name, so 'vs.' is the separator. The album page gives 制作方 = VAGUEDGE，Heterodyne., 类型 = EP，合作, 编号 VDFD-0003, 备注 「以VAGUEDGE DIES FOR DIES IRAE vs. Heterodyne.名义発布」, with Heterodyne. a circle 主催 Hellnear — https://thwiki.cc/VAGUEDGE, https://thwiki.cc/DEATHMARCH_OF_JIANGSHI'S_PARADISE. Corroborated locally: the VDFD-001/002 releases sit inside the standalone [VAGUEDGE] dir with tracks credited to the artist 'VDFD'.

[西明石俗物園×東生駒珍物園].evidence: THBWiki gives 属夜鎮陽 制作方 = 東生駒珍物園，西明石俗物園 with all five tracks arranged by にぬきボム (東生駒珍物園, formerly にぬきボ村) and Illustration by fu kka (西明石俗物園); 西明石俗物園's own page says 「该作品是与 東生駒珍物園 合作创作的」 — https://thwiki.cc/属夜鎮陽, https://thwiki.cc/西明石俗物園.

[Aqua Style／ひえろぐらふ].evidence: ひえろぐらふ is a separate music-production circle, not part of Aqua Style. Its own サークル概要 states 「ひえろぐらふは音楽製作サークルです。現在は「はちみつくまさん」「AQUASTYLE」の両サークルを中心に楽曲を提供しています」 and 「このサークルは「にょ。」と「棟方」の２人サークルです」 — https://web.archive.org/web/20110726030626id_/http://hierograph.net/info.html. TouhouDB models AQUA STYLE (id 5987, Circle, run by JYUNYA) and ひえろぐらふ (id 10681) as distinct artists and credits most AQUA STYLE albums as 'にょ。, AQUA STYLE'. Locally the dir mixes album_artist values AQUA STYLE / AQUASTYLE with 'ひえろぐらふ / Aqua Style' and bare 'ひえろぐらふ'. Note [Aqua Style-ひえろぐらふ] is a duplicate of this directory under a different separator.

[Liz Triangle×MiddleIsland].evidence: MiddleIsland is a genuine circle: THBWiki lists it as a 同人音乐社团 founded 2003, 主催 中島岬, site middleisland.net (https://thwiki.cc/MiddleIsland), and TouhouDB registers it with artistType Circle. Track artist 'Misaki Nakajima' on this disc is that person, and he is credited as 「中島岬 MiddleIsland」 on other Liz Triangle albums. Liz Triangle exists standalone as [Liz Triangle] りすとら. Medium because neither wiki lists this preview disc, so the joint billing rests on the disc's own title text plus the member split.

[幽閉サテライト×神楽めあ×少女フラクタル].evidence: The ALBUM tag reads '神楽めあ&幽閉少女コラボ vol.2' — explicitly a collaboration. [幽閉サテライト] and [少女フラクタル] exist standalone and were already linked together in [幽閉サテライト×少女フラクタル]; 神楽めあ is separately credited as a track artist inside [C-CLAYS].

[想謳×結律 心庵 ].evidence: The circle's own site header reads 「ヒメキ(媛貴)の個人サークル「想謳×律結 心庵」公式HP」 — a one-person circle whose whole name contains the × — with footer Copyright©想謳×律結 心庵 (http://katharusis.nobody.jp/); third parties use the full string as one artist name. The embedded album_artist tag '想謳×律結　心庵' matches, and the directory has 律結 transposed to 結律. Neither 想謳 nor 律結 exists as an independent entity.

[CHAOS MIXER x Thrive at Thrice].evidence: album_artist is 'Thrive at Thrice/CHAOS MIXER' — the order is reversed relative to the directory, proving these are two names rather than one string; [CHAOS MIXER] exists standalone.

[Pizuya's Cell ✕ BLOOD STAIN CHILD].evidence: Pizuya's Cell exists standalone as [ぴずやの独房] Pizuya's Cell and is already a linked member of three other collaborations in the v6 run record; BLOOD STAIN CHILD is the Japanese metal band jointly named in album_artist.

[ぴずやの独房 ✕ BLOOD STAIN CHILD].evidence: Same release as the Pizuya's-Cell-spelled twin — both dirs hold PCBSC-0001 共鳴領域, 4 tracks, with the identical album_artist tag "Pizuya's Cell ✕ BLOOD STAIN CHILD".

[かっくん×ぶるっくりん☆すてーしょん×groovin' bullets].evidence: [ぶるっくりん☆すてーしょん] exists standalone; the three tracks are credited one each to かっくん, ぶるっくりん and ｓｉｇ*, matching the three named parties.

[J＆B／すたじおたわし／A-HEAD].evidence: All three exist standalone and the comma-spelled twin [J&B,すたじおたわし,A-HEAD] was already decomposed to exactly these three in the v6 run record; only the fullwidth ＆ and ／ defeated the auto-rule here.

[Next Reflection x NIZI-RINGO].evidence: album_artist is 'NextReflection & NiZi-RiNGO' — an explicit two-party credit; NIZI-RINGO matches the standalone circle [NiZi RiNGO].
